claim: A length-normalized, reference-free training objective drives unlearning pressure deeper into intermediate representations compared to a standard objective.
falsifier: Train two unlearning models on the same base model and forget set, one with a standard objective and one with a length-normalized reference-free objective; compare their activation-patching-based depth scores.

conditions: configuration comparison on the same model and dataset
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported model, dataset, and specific objective variants; transfer beyond them is unestablished.
